title: Assessing the Performance of ChatGPT in Answering Patients’ Questions Regarding Congenital Bicuspid Aortic Valve

live_model.evidence: "one of the many versions of the ChatGPT (GPT-4o-2024-05-13) was used in the current study" (Limitations); "A free version of ChatGPT (model version: gpt-4o-2024-05-13) ... was used" (Methods)

prompt.note: Only 5 fixed questions were asked once each.

claim.metric: Author/physician quality score (qualitative rubric) for ChatGPT's answer to Question 1

data.source: 5 author-written clinical questions about bicuspid aortic valve, printed in Table 1

notes: Cureus case-report-style paper. Explicitly the free/consumer ChatGPT web interface (not API); only 5 questions total, each scored subjectively by the author against her own clinical judgment (no fixed numeric answer key).
